about.description: ANTHROPIC is a private-company perpetual listed on OKX, tracking Anthropic, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification. OKX quotes this market as an implied per-share value against an assumed 10 billion share count following its 2026-06-30 rebase, so the price is about a tenth of the same market on venues that assume roughly 1 billion shares.
